# PR 2): a persona name or alias in the free text or body of any record,
# read under every reading of NAME_READINGS (word_variants), on a copy of
# Columns: name, file, find, replace, expect. A code point is written
# \u{XXXX}. Every find string occurs exactly once in its file. The
# tatweel row passes on purpose: R5 keeps \w as its word boundary in every
# reading, so the low line, the tatweel's prototype, joins a name to the
# next word as in R0 (a handle such as riley_placeholder_zoë in
# params.campaign.artifact is no name for R5); render rules 4 and 9 read it
# as a separator on the built page (render-persona/name-tatweel-*).
# Fix round 1: U+00D7 after a name is a boundary only for R0 (the
# skeleton reads it as "x"); U+0307 is a mark the names drop; U+01C0 is a
# stroke, read as the space; the reversed run with a pipe needs V3; and the
# alias "Ali" passes next to the "all" of a body.
# Fix round 2: a stroke is no outer boundary of a name ("Irene" does not
# hold "Rene"); a written l for the capital I of a name (at the start, in
# a word of capitals, inside a word) and U+4E28 and its strokes are found;
# "Il" next to "ill", "Li" next to "Il" and "Ali" next to "ALL" pass.
